description: Xovris's way of working on code, in GitHub Copilot (its CLI, and VS Code's chat on the Copilot harness): at the start it hands the agent the repository's test command and what it points to; at every stop it holds done until no existing test is weakened, a test proves the change and the tests pass. The events are named as Claude Code names them, so Copilot sends the same fields the one script reads; the plugin's folder is CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, which Copilot sets for a plugin's hooks (read from copilot 1.0.112 itself, 14 Nov 2026).
